title: Half-Life Crowbar for MC Swords
description: minecraft resource pack that changes some minecraft swords to the half-life crowbar.
body:
**information**

this minecraft resource pack changes 4 minecraft swords to be the crowbar from half-life

the changed swords include:
- iron sword for the default crowbar
- gold sword for a golden crowbar
- diamond crowbar for a diamond crowbar
- netherite sword for a black & orange crowbar

this also changes the item model when dropped
